parent.name: Deutsche Telekom (via Magyar Telekom)
parent.note: As of 31 Dec 2025 / Q1-2026, the majority shareholder of record is Deutsche Telekom Europe B.V. with 54.6% of share capital (S16, S07); ultimately controlled by Deutsche Telekom AG. Earlier filings reported 53.54% (FY2024, S15). Deutsche Telekom historically holds HT through its DT Europe holding structure rather than directly through Magyar Telekom; group executives overlap with Magyar Telekom.

market_position.summary: Croatia's leading telecom operator and #1 telecom brand; largest investor in the market, ~44% mobile customer market share.
